visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with pigtails, wearing a beige sweatshirt with a deer logo and blue jeans, walks on a concrete path while an adult in blue jeans and white sneakers holds her hands for balance; the lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) The toddler and another young girl lean against a red metal railing overlooking a zoo enclosure with green grass and trees, while an adult stands nearby; the toddler holds a small piece of fruit in her hand. (3) A black alpaca with shorn wool eats hay from a wooden feeder under a shelter in a dusty outdoor enclosure; the camera is at a high angle looking down at the animal. (4) The toddler walks down wide concrete stairs holding an adult's hand, looking down at her white sneakers which have strawberry patterns on the cuffs; a green jade-like bracelet is visible on the adult's wrist. (5) The toddler waves her hand while being held by an adult near a wooden fence, looking at spotted deer resting on the grass; the background shows rocky formations and some urban buildings in the distance. (6) The toddler peers through a gap in dense green bushes over a concrete ledge to see a tiger sleeping in a shaded enclosure; the scene is shot at eye-level with the child. (7) A tiger is seen lying still in the shade of trees and rocks within its enclosure; dry leaves and dirt cover the ground. (8) The toddler walks on a gravel path and then looks at an emu standing near a wooden fence and large tortoises on the ground; the environment is open and sunny. (9) The toddler and an older woman are seen inside a transparent acrylic dome exhibit, laughing and waving; they are surrounded by green grass and white flowers. (10) The toddler leans on a silver railing over a green pond where a hippo is partially submerged, swimming slowly; several other people are visible in the background on a viewing platform.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-pitched, cheerful background music featuring electronic synthesizers at a moderate tempo. A female voice speaks warmly in Traditional Chinese, introducing the zoo visit, accompanied by the soft sound of walking on concrete and the toddler's occasional high-pitched vocalizations. (2) As the video cuts to different animal exhibits, a cartoon-style 'pop' sound effect highlights the transition. The grandmother and mother engage in a playful dialogue with the toddler, whose voice is bright and inquisitive. Distant crowd chatter and gentle wind noise form a subtle background layer. (3) A sequence of incidental sounds like the rustle of clothes and light footsteps is audible as the toddler moves. The music maintains a constant joyful energy. Short 'ding' sound effects coincide with the appearance of Variety-style subtitles on screen. (4) In the final phase, the toddler's vocalizations become more energetic as she greets the hippo. The female adult voices provide encouraging responses, creating a dense interplay of speech and music. The track ends with a soft synthesizer fade-out following the toddler's final giggle.
